case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70210.text:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We have looked at your request carefully for our shop. We can offer you a price of €36.00 per unit. 

We always aim to deliver top quality from our machines for your orders, and we look forward to working together on this project. Let us know if this works for you.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

sup:70240.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your business!

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain fully flexible and look forward to building a great relationship together. Let us know if this works for you!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

move.subject: HX pump shaft RFQ – revised commercial and delivery terms
move.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

Thank you for your quotation. Please review the attached counterproposal for the fixed two-year DAP programme.

sup:70240 records your standard lead time as 42 days; can you confirm the earliest repeatable delivery schedule for this shaft?

part:320070 specifies a planned lead time of 35 days, which we propose for the agreement.

Could you provide a per-piece breakdown of material, machining and logistics costs, and identify production efficiencies that preserve the drawing requirements?

Please consider €28.00 per piece with 60-day payment and 35-day delivery, with all fixed RFQ terms unchanged.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are very eager to work together and grow as your partner!

Our current offer is a price of €34.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. We can do 42 days lead time as you saw in our standard, but 35 days is too tight right now. Also, 60 days payment is also a bit long for us, so we'd like to stick to 45 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and Lieferzeit 42 days: €33.00 per unit.

For your background, material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our offer is a price of €32.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days.

Hi again, thanks for the new options! We love the 14-day payment idea, so we can drop our price to €32.00 per piece with the 42-day lead time. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €32.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. We can't cut machining costs without changing the drawing, but doubling the lot size could save some money. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. With overtime we can deliver in 35 days, at a premium.

Plant Engineer: From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.93 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.70 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.44 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Could you review both packages and separate any overtime premium? All fixed RFQ terms remain unchanged.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
